mapper.insert: insert into goodscollection.noticelist(noticeTitle, noticeContent, dateTime, ipId) VALUES (#{noticeTitle},#{noticeContent},#{dateTime},#{ipId})
mapper.delete: delete from goodscollection.noticelist where ipId=#{ipId} and dateTime=#{dateTime}
mapper.select: select * from goodscollection.noticelist where ipId=#{ipId} and dateTime=#{dateTime}
